Import a Kubernetes JSON List or the collector’s inventory. Processing stays in this browser tab; imported data is not uploaded or persisted by the app.

Collect from your source cluster

The collector runs read-only kubectl queries using your explicit context. It skips Secret and ConfigMap queries and omits inline environment values. Other fields may still contain sensitive information; inspect the export locally.

python3 collect.py --context SOURCE --output inventory.json
